notes.title: DEMO UPDATE!
notes.notes:
[b]The demo is updated in Steam![/b]

The demoversion of COP BASTARD has received a major update and now available!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41157726/f22d4e0cc10994e1c43d974a25ceeaf64721ad37.png[/img]
What changes have been made to the demo version:
1. Improving the behavior of AI
2. Sound fixes
3. Added "Rage meter" (press H to see what happens)
4. VFX updates
5. SFX updates
6. FOV and VSync adjustments in menu
7. Adjustments in demo level
5. and more little tweaks.

I would love to hear your feedback, so please go on.

Best regards,
targim.
